introduction: The agent-fox knowledge retrieval system provides context to coder sessions via multiple channels; this spec removes five unused channels (errata, ADRs, verdicts, cross-spec summaries, and prior-run items) from the codebase, DuckDB schema, and all related tests and documentation, retaining only the three channels that produce actionable value.

glossary.MADR: Markdown Architectural Decision Records — a lightweight format for documenting architecture decisions.
glossary.[ADR]: A prompt tag used to delimit ADR context injected into coder prompts.
glossary.[CROSS-GROUP]: A prompt tag used to delimit cross-group verdict context injected into coder prompts.
glossary.[CROSS-SPEC]: A prompt tag used to delimit cross-spec summary context injected into coder prompts.
glossary.[ERRATA]: A prompt tag used to delimit errata context injected into coder prompts.
glossary.[PRIOR-RUN]: A prompt tag used to delimit prior-run finding/verdict context injected into coder prompts.
glossary.[VERIFY]: A prompt tag used to delimit verdict context injected into coder prompts.
glossary._generate_errata(): A method in result_handler.py that generates errata records from session results.
glossary._query_adrs(): A private method in fox_provider.py that queries the ADR channel.
glossary._query_cross_group_verdicts(): A private method in fox_provider.py that queries cross-group verdict items.
glossary._query_cross_spec_summaries(): A private method in fox_provider.py that queries session summaries from other specs.
glossary._query_errata(): A private method in fox_provider.py that queries the errata channel.
glossary._query_prior_run_findings(): A private method in fox_provider.py that queries findings and verdicts from previous run timestamps.
glossary._query_verdicts(): A private method in fox_provider.py that queries the verdicts channel.
glossary.adr_entries: A DuckDB table storing Architecture Decision Records ingested from MADR-formatted files.
glossary.cross_group_items: A variable in retrieve() that accumulates knowledge items sourced from other task groups within the same spec.
glossary.detect_adr_changes: A function that compares on-disk ADR files against stored adr_entries to identify changes.
glossary.errata: A DuckDB table and associated channel for indexing and retrieving error corrections identified during runs.
glossary.fox_provider: The knowledge-provider component (fox_provider.py) that assembles retrieval context for each coder session.
glossary.fox_provider.py: The Python module that orchestrates knowledge retrieval and assembles context for coder sessions.
glossary.index_errata_from_markdown(): A startup function that parses Markdown files to populate the errata table.
glossary.ingest_adr: A function that reads MADR-formatted files and inserts parsed ADR records into adr_entries.
glossary.insert_verdicts(): A function in review_store.py that writes new verdict records to the verification_results table.
glossary.items_with_ids: A list in retrieve() that tracks injected knowledge items paired with their source record IDs for deduplication.
glossary.max_cross_group_items: A configuration cap on the number of cross-group knowledge items injected per retrieval call.
glossary.migrations.py: The Python module that manages versioned DuckDB schema migrations for agent-fox.
glossary.nightshift/_startup.py: The startup script for the nightshift scheduler that initialises agent-fox subsystems.
glossary.parse_madr: A function that parses a MADR-formatted Markdown file into a structured ADR record.
glossary.query_active_verdicts(): A function in review_store.py that retrieves non-superseded verdict records.
glossary.query_cross_group_verdicts(): A function in review_store.py that retrieves verdict records across task groups.
glossary.query_cross_spec_summaries(): A function in summary_store.py that retrieves session summaries belonging to other specs.
glossary.query_prior_run_findings(): A function in review_store.py that retrieves review findings filtered by prior run timestamps.
glossary.query_prior_run_verdicts(): A function in review_store.py that retrieves verdict records filtered by prior run timestamps.
glossary.result_handler.py: The Python module (agentfox/engine/result_handler.py) that processes session results after completion.
glossary.retrieve(): The top-level method in fox_provider.py that orchestrates all knowledge-channel queries and assembles the final context payload.
glossary.review_ids: A set tracked in retrieve() that records the IDs of review finding items already injected to avoid duplicates.
glossary.review_store.py: The Python module responsible for persisting and querying review findings and verdict records in DuckDB.
glossary.run.py: The Python module (agentfox/engine/run.py) that orchestrates a full agent-fox run.
glossary.session_lifecycle.py: The Python module (agentfox/engine/session_lifecycle.py) that manages individual session state transitions.
glossary.session_summaries: A DuckDB table storing per-session context summaries used by the same-spec summaries channel.
glossary.summary_store.py: The Python module responsible for persisting and querying session summaries in DuckDB.
glossary.validate_verdict(): A function in review_store.py that validates verdict record structure before insertion.
glossary.verdict_ids: A set tracked in retrieve() that records the IDs of verdict items already injected to avoid duplicates.
glossary.verification_results: A DuckDB table storing verdict records written by the verifier archetype.
glossary.packages/agentfox/agentfox/knowledge/err: The full path to the errata module being deleted.
glossary.packages/agentfox/agentfox/knowledge/adr: The full path to the ADR module being deleted.
glossary.errata.py: Short name for the errata knowledge module (packages/agentfox/agentfox/knowledge/errata.py).
glossary.adr.py: Short name for the ADR knowledge module (packages/agentfox/agentfox/knowledge/adr.py).
glossary.query_same_spec_summaries(): A function in summary_store.py that retrieves session summaries for the current spec (retained).
glossary.index_errata_from_markdown: The function name string used in grep checks (see index_errata_from_markdown() for the function itself).
glossary.(text, review_id): A 2-tuple format representing a review finding text paired with its database record ID.
glossary.Retrieved {reviews} review + {cross_grou: The simplified log format emitted by retrieve() after removal of the five unused channels.
glossary.test_errata.py: Test file covering the errata module — to be deleted entirely.
glossary.test_adr.py: Test file covering the ADR module — to be deleted entirely.
glossary.test_adr_props.py: Property test file covering the ADR module — to be deleted entirely.
glossary.test_verdict_normalization.py: Test file covering verdict normalization — to be deleted entirely.
glossary.test_cross_run_carryforward.py: Test file covering cross-run carry-forward — to be deleted entirely.
glossary.test_errata_on_blocking.py: Test file covering errata generation on blocking results — to be deleted entirely.
glossary.test_fox_provider_summaries.py: Test file covering fox_provider summary retrieval — cross-spec portions to be removed.
glossary.test_summary_store.py: Test file covering summary_store CRUD operations — cross-spec portions to be removed.
glossary.test_summary_lifecycle.py: Test file covering summary lifecycle — cross-spec portions to be removed.
glossary.test_review_store.py: Test file covering review_store operations — verdict portions to be removed.
glossary.test_review_store_props.py: Property test file covering review_store — verdict portions to be removed.
glossary.test_retrieval_fixes_smoke.py: Smoke test file covering retrieval fixes — prior-run portions to be removed.
glossary.test_duckdb_reader_writer_smoke.py: Smoke test file covering DuckDB reader/writer — ADR/errata portions to be removed.
glossary.test_duckdb_reader_writer_idempotency.py: Idempotency test file for DuckDB reader/writer — errata portions to be removed.

requirements.title: Drop unused DuckDB tables via new migration

user_story.goal: have a new migration version in `migrations.py` that drops the `errata`, `adr_entries`, and `verification_results` tables
user_story.benefit: the schema no longer contains dead tables that are never populated or queried

acceptance_criteria.action: executes DROP TABLE IF EXISTS statements for `errata`, `adr_entries`, and `verification_results`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: each DROP statement completes without error; the tables no longer exist in the DuckDB database
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the migration runner applies the new migration version

acceptance_criteria.action: retains the `session_summaries` table and does not include it in any DROP statement
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the `session_summaries` table continues to exist and is queryable after the migration

acceptance_criteria.action: assigns the new migration a version number strictly greater than all existing migration versions so it is applied exactly once and in order
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the migration version table records the new version after successful application

edge_cases.action: uses DROP TABLE IF EXISTS so the migration still succeeds without raising an error
edge_cases.return_contract: migration completes successfully with no error raised
edge_cases.error_condition: one or more of the target tables (`errata`, `adr_entries`, `verification_results`) do not exist at migration time (e.g. fresh database)

execution_paths.title: Agent-fox run startup — no errata indexing

steps.action: starts an agent-fox run (via run.py or nightshift/_startup.py)
applies the new migration version, dropping `errata`, `adr_entries`, and `verification_results` tables (using DROP TABLE IF EXISTS)
observes that startup completes without errata-related log messages or errors

execution_paths.title: Coder session knowledge retrieval — three channels only

steps.action: calls `retrieve()` in `fox_provider` to assemble context for a coding task
queries only the three retained channels: review findings, cross-group reviews, and same-spec context summaries
assembles `items_with_ids` containing only `(text, review_id)` tuples, applies `max_cross_group_items` cap to cross-group reviews, and emits the simplified log line
receives a context payload with no `[ERRATA]`, `[ADR]`, `[VERIFY]`, `[CROSS-SPEC]`, `[CROSS-GROUP]` verdict, or `[PRIOR-RUN]` sections

execution_paths.title: Developer runs full test suite after cleanup

steps.action: runs the full test suite (e.g. `pytest`) after all code deletions and updates have been applied
discovers no deleted test files and imports no deleted modules
executes all remaining tests for review, cross-group review, and same-spec summary channels
observes all tests pass with exit code 0 and no import or reference errors

error_handling.condition: Migration is applied to a database where `errata`, `adr_entries`, or `verification_results` does not exist (e.g. fresh install)
error_handling.behavior: The migration uses DROP TABLE IF EXISTS, so it completes successfully without raising an error.

error_handling.condition: A retained test file contains an import of a deleted module (`errata.py` or `adr.py`)
